description: A master of martial arts, harnessing the power of the body in pursuit of physical and spiritual perfection.

features.name: Unarmored Defense
features.tldr: While you are not wearing any armor and not wielding a shield, your AC includes your Wisdom modifier.

features.name: Martial Arts
features.tldr: Gain mastery of combat styles using unarmed strikes and monk weapons, scaling your damage die and granting bonus attacks.

features.name: Ki
features.tldr: Harness a pool of ki energy to fuel mystical martial feats like Flurry of Blows, Patient Defense, and Step of the Wind.

features.name: Unarmored Movement
features.tldr: Your speed increases by 10 feet while you are not wearing armor or wielding a shield.

features.name: Deflect Missiles
features.tldr: Use your reaction to deflect or catch missiles when you are hit by a ranged weapon attack.

features.name: Monastic Tradition
features.tldr: Choose a tradition that shapes your spiritual and martial philosophy.

features.name: Slow Fall
features.tldr: Use your reaction when you fall to reduce any falling damage you take.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.tldr: Increase one ability score by 2, or two different scores by 1 (or select a feat).

features.name: Extra Attack
features.tldr: You can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

features.name: Stunning Strike
features.tldr: Interfere with the flow of ki in an opponent's body, forcing a Constitution save or stunning them.

features.name: Ki-Empowered Strikes
features.tldr: Your unarmed strikes count as magical for the purpose of overcoming resistance and immunity.

features.name: Monastic Tradition Feature
features.tldr: Gain a specialized feature granted by your chosen Monastic Tradition.

features.name: Evasion
features.tldr: Your instinctive agility lets you dodge out of the way of certain area effects, taking no damage on a success.

features.name: Stillness of Mind
features.tldr: Use an action to end one effect on yourself that is causing you to be charmed or frightened.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.tldr: Increase one ability score by 2, or two different scores by 1 (or select a feat).

features.name: Unarmored Movement Improvement
features.tldr: You gain the ability to move along vertical surfaces and across liquids on your turn without falling.

features.name: Purity of Body
features.tldr: Your mastery of the ki flowing through you makes you immune to disease and poison.

features.name: Monastic Tradition Feature
features.tldr: Gain a specialized feature granted by your chosen Monastic Tradition.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.tldr: Increase one ability score by 2, or two different scores by 1 (or select a feat).

features.name: Tongue of the Sun and Moon
features.tldr: Learn to touch the ki of other minds so that you understand all spoken languages.

features.name: Diamond Soul
features.tldr: Gain proficiency in all saving throws, and spend ki to reroll a failed save.

features.name: Timeless Body
features.tldr: Your ki sustains you so that you suffer none of the frailty of old age and don't need food or water.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.tldr: Increase one ability score by 2, or two different scores by 1 (or select a feat).

features.name: Monastic Tradition Feature
features.tldr: Gain the capstone feature granted by your chosen Monastic Tradition.

features.name: Empty Body
features.tldr: Spend ki to become invisible and resistant to all damage except force, or cast Astral Projection.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.tldr: Increase one ability score by 2, or two different scores by 1 (or select a feat).

features.name: Perfect Self
features.tldr: When you roll for initiative and have no ki points remaining, you regain 4 ki points.
